docs.purpose: A monthly read on the Toronto construction market for an operator. It opens with headline numbers - permits and dollar value this month against the same month last year, plus the busiest company - then charts twelve months of activity split by permit type and by residential versus commercial, lead volumes across all twenty trades with a year-ago comparison, the mix of work scopes, and which income tiers of neighbourhood are seeing residential permits.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing from the database directly. Every value arrives through one contract: `/api/admin/market-metrics`. Behind that contract, the data comes from `mv_monthly_permit_stats`, `neighbourhoods`, `permits` and `trades`.
docs.under_126: **RE-PROJECT** — it writes nothing and holds no Layer-3 store, so the move is short — the server already assembles the payload and only the rendering is client-side. It renders through the REPORT renderer (read-only; `outputs` and `state` forced to `"none"`, a field whitelist that must equal the contract's), reading by reference: `/api/admin/market-metrics`. It owns no component of its own, so its `owns.components[]` is an empty array — a legal answer, written down.

versioning.why: The six-key payload is typed by interfaces declared inside the page file itself and has exactly one caller, so a shape change is one commit with no Zod mirror to bump.

inputs.why: One contract, fetched with a bare fetch inside useEffect rather than a named hook — the hook-only sweep would have missed this page entirely.

outputs.why: Forced on REPORT and true here: the route exports GET only and the page has no form or action.

state.why: It owns no state in any declared layer — no TanStack query, no store, no persistence; the payload lives in component useState for the life of the mount, which Spec 99 §3 has no row for.

staleness.why: Each mount issues one uncached fetch straight to the database; there is no cache layer, no polling and no revalidate directive on the route.

session.why: The page is on the /admin/* arm, but its contract does NOT import verifyAdminAuth — the only gate left is the presence-only middleware check, so the declared class is stronger than the enforced one.

rls_class.why: permits, permit_trades, trades, neighbourhoods and the monthly materialized view are none of the ten Class-A tables and are not profiles, so Class B by the §2 default.

checks.why: The route assembles six named keys and every sub-payload is an explicit pick in queries.ts, so the surface's field set must set-equal the contract's projection rather than drifting behind a row spread.
Empty is per-section here: a chart with no rows renders "No data" while the rest of the report still renders, so a blank page is a defect not an empty result.
DECLARED AND CURRENTLY FAILING: guards.session admin is not enforced by the contract, which calls no verifyAdminAuth.

errors.why: A failed fetch renders an error block in place of the report; the route's own failure path returns a bare { error } rather than the envelope, so there is nothing structured to render from.

classes.ui: inline error block replacing the report

emits.why: No captureEvent, no track, no ledger — the page imports nothing from the observability layer.

offers.why: An internal operator tool renders no sponsored placement; no offers/placements table is reached from any file it owns.

metering.why: Nothing here is billable or quota-bearing: no usage_events / ledger write is reached from this surface or its contracts.

config.why: It reads no logic_variables row; every band and threshold in the report is a literal in queries.ts.

sharing.why: /api/admin/market-metrics has exactly one caller in the tree — this page.

limitations.what: A REPORT with no plausibility check
limitations.measured: Nothing in the tree bounds the numbers this page renders — no SQL plausibility assertion exists for the KPI, activity or neighbourhood payloads, so plausibility is honestly "none" rather than a declared set.

limitations.what: Every chart is hand-rolled from divs and inline SVG
limitations.measured: No charting library is imported anywhere in the 462-line page, so axis labels and series names have no library-provided accessible structure.

limitations.what: touch_target_min_px has no legal answer for a desktop-only admin page
limitations.measured: The schema allows only UNRESEARCHED or an integer >= 44, and nothing in this surface declares a 44px floor (grep for min-h-[44 / h-11 over its owned files returns nothing).
limitations.check_id: none — vocabulary gap, escalated per Spec 128 §4

notes: Spec 26 Sec 3.3 covers this route by name and its Target Files list both the page and /api/admin/market-metrics/route.ts. 'empty' is per-section: individual charts render 'No data' when their array is empty while the rest of the report still renders. All charts are hand-rolled with divs/SVG - no charting library is imported. DISAGREEMENT (tree wins): src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:8 states verifyAdminAuth is the FIRST LINE of every src/app/api/admin/**/route.ts (Spec 33 Sec 5), and the routes this surface calls do not import it at all - the only gate left is the presence-only middleware check, which middleware.ts:108 itself documents as non-cryptographic. identity.owner is UNRESEARCHED estate-wide: no owner registry exists in the tree, so naming one would be an invention rather than a measurement. a11y.touch_target_min_px is UNRESEARCHED because its vocabulary (UNRESEARCHED or an integer >= 44) has no member for a desktop-only admin page that declares no floor.

measured_gate.why: classifyRoute('/admin/market-metrics') matches the admin-pages arm via `pathname.startsWith('/admin/')` -> 'admin'.

programme.why: The other product. Inventoried only, fenced by Spec 128 R-03.
